chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch.521 – Li Huowang's Deadliest Ritual Yet
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang triggers Intercalating the Five Phases, becoming a temporary juggernaut. The Eldest Princess falls, but the price is his own body. A turning point in the Ao-Jing sect arc.
og_title: The Furnace of Flesh – Chapter 521 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
og_description: A forbidden ritual turns Li Huowang into a weapon no one can stop—but the cost is revealed in a hollow shell and crawling skin.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch.521 – He paid with his lungs, his liver, and more.
twitter_description: Li Huowang kills the Eldest Princess by tearing out his own organs. The State Preceptor walks away. No power comes cheap.

lore_anchors.definition: A forbidden ritual from the Thousand Greats Record that overwrites the practitioner's internal Five Phases with parasitic flesh, granting immense but temporary power at a catastrophic physical cost.
A fictional syncretic sect combining Zoroastrianism and Nestorian Christianity, whose rituals involve fire, flesh-worms, and self-immolation to channel power from the primordial god Bashe.

A high-ranking imperial Daoist master serving as the emperor's spiritual advisor. Huangfu Tiangang, the Grand Liang State Preceptor, is depicted as a detached, world-weary figure riding a green ox backward.
The emperor's elder sister; a high-ranking imperial noble whose authority extends to commanding guards and directing court mages. Her defeat here marks a major shift in the capital's power balance.
